title: Article 14 — Equality before law (Fundamental Rights subject)

content.overview: Article 14 forbids the State from denying equality before the law or the equal protection of the laws. Reasonable classification is permitted; arbitrariness is not.
content.study: Two limbs: equality before the law and equal protection. After Maneka Gandhi, Article 14 informs fairness of procedure under Article 21. Practice: plead class, object, differentia, nexus, and arbitrariness. Canonical: provision:india:constitution-art-14.

sections.heading: Reasonable classification
sections.body: Intelligible differentia; rational relation to object.

sections.heading: Golden triangle
sections.body: Articles 14, 19 and 21 read together when liberty or freedom is challenged (Maneka Gandhi).
